_meta.note: Curated subset of the AGS Beers Criteria (2023) for the demo. Not a complete review.

rules.title: Benzodiazepine in an older adult
rules.plainLanguage: This sleeping or anxiety medicine can increase confusion, falls, and fractures in people aged 65 and over.
rules.action: Ask your doctor whether a safer option is possible. Do not stop it suddenly on your own.

rules.title: Regular NSAID use in an older adult
rules.plainLanguage: Regular use of this pain reliever can increase the risk of stomach bleeding, kidney problems, and raised blood pressure in older adults.
rules.action: Ask your doctor about the lowest effective dose and whether a safer alternative fits.

rules.title: First-generation antihistamine in an older adult
rules.plainLanguage: This allergy medicine can cause drowsiness, confusion, dry mouth, and urinary retention in older adults.
rules.action: Ask your pharmacist about a non-sedating alternative.
